verdict.rationale: Agents connect through the official MCP server and can read the financial Model directly or ask Ari through edit_chats/inspect_chats. Answers come from a live, formula-driven Model whose numbers users can open and check, and the docs say outputs print their lineage back to the source line. The core of the story is delivered, but the separation between engine-computed figures and LLM-generated text is implied rather than stated. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that agent answers are computed by the engine rather than generated, clearer documentation of how lineage reaches MCP/agent responses, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
